record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Let Y be a smooth convex billiard table. If the billiard flow on Y is an integrable Hamiltonian system with two degrees of freedom, must Y be an ellipse?

evidence.quote: Задача 1a. Пусть Y — гладкий выпуклый биллиардный стол. Если биллиардный поток на Y — это интегрируемая гамильтонова система, то Y является эллипсом.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a smooth, strictly convex, bounded planar domain, and consider the billiard dynamics inside $Y$: a point particle moves in straight lines in the interior of $Y$ and reflects elastically (angle of incidence equal to angle of reflection) upon hitting the boundary $\partial Y$. The associated billiard flow is a Hamiltonian system with two degrees of freedom on the unit tangent bundle of $Y$.

The flow is said to be (Liouville-)integrable if there exists a non-constant first integral, smooth on an open neighborhood of $\partial Y$ in the phase space, that is functionally independent of the energy and is preserved by the billiard map.

Question: Suppose the billiard flow on $Y$ is an integrable Hamiltonian system with two degrees of freedom. Must the boundary $\partial Y$ be an ellipse?
artifact.status_search_result: The Birkhoff conjecture (that smooth strictly convex integrable billiards are ellipses) remains open in full generality. Significant partial results are known: Bialy proved that totally integrable billiards on the sphere are ellipses; Kaloshin–Sorrentino established a local version (small smooth integrable perturbations of an ellipse must be ellipses); Glutsyuk and Bialy–Mironov proved the polynomial Birkhoff conjecture on surfaces of constant curvature. The general (Hamiltonian) form remains an open problem.

status_evidence.title: On the local Birkhoff conjecture for convex billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Local version proved: small smooth integrable perturbations of ellipses are ellipses.
status_evidence.claim: Local Birkhoff conjecture solved; global remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the integrability of Birkhoff billiards
status_evidence.snippet: This naive question has given rise to one of the most famous open problems in dynamical systems: the so-called Birkhoff conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The general Birkhoff conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: On polynomially integrable Birkhoff billiards on surfaces of constant curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Every polynomially integrable real bounded planar billiard with C^2-smooth boundary is an ellipse.
status_evidence.claim: Polynomial version of the conjecture is solved.
